topic.name: ask-engineering-question
topic.description: Document-grounded engineering Q&A. Returns an answer built only from connected SharePoint sources, with a citation for every engineering claim. States uncertainty and defers rather than guessing. Tenant-neutral declarative design.
triggerPhrases: what does the procedure say about

slots.name: assetType
slots.prompt: Is this about a transmission (AS 2885) or distribution (AS/NZS 4645) asset? Confirm so the two are not mixed.
slots.note: If the question implies a standards or asset-specific answer and this is unknown or ambiguous, ask before answering. Do not blend AS2885 and AS4645.

slots.name: project
slots.prompt: Which project does this relate to? (optional, narrows project-document grounding)

retrievalRules: Prefer DocumentStatus = Approved; exclude Superseded; flag reliance on In Review.
Filter on AssetType and StandardReference so Transmission (AS 2885) and Distribution (AS/NZS 4645) are never blended.
StandardsExtracts are eligible only when LicenceConfirmed = Yes (OQ-1 precondition); otherwise excluded.
Answer only from retrieved passages. Never invent or paraphrase clause numbers, acceptance criteria, or requirements.

answer.description: Grounded answer composed only from retrieved content.

itemFields.name: clauseSection
itemFields.description: Clause/section ONLY if printed in the licensed source; else '[PLACEHOLDER - to be filled from licensed <standard> <clause> rev <year>]'.

itemFields.name: revision
itemFields.description: Revision/year ONLY if stated by the source.

uncertaintyFallback.behaviour: State uncertainty plainly, name the authoritative document to consult, and defer to the responsible engineer. Do not guess. If standards text is unavailable pending licensing, reference OQ-1 and leave the clause placeholder.
uncertaintyFallback.assetTypeAmbiguityBehaviour: If the question appears to mix or not specify Transmission vs Distribution, ask the user to confirm asset type before answering.
